title: Help & support
q1: How do I pay my subscription?
a1: On the Payments page choose "Pay with InstaPay", send the amount, then enter the transfer reference. The building admin or treasurer confirms it and your balance goes down.
q2: How do I see the building's treasury?
a2: The balance is on the dashboard, and the monthly statement shows what came in and went out. You can share it with neighbours as a PDF.
q3: How do I join my building?
a3: Ask the building admin for an invite link, sign up with the same email they invited, then pick your unit.
q4: Why is an expense missing from the treasury?
a4: Large expenses need the treasurer or chair to approve them first, and only approved ones count. Monthly subscriptions and late fees are charges to units, not spending.
q5: How do I report a fault in the building?
a5: On the Maintenance page add a report describing the fault. The admin turns it into a work order and follows it until it is done.

q7: How do I install the app on my phone?
a7: On Android choose "Install app" from the prompt or the browser menu. On iPhone open the site in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
q8: How do I change the language?
a8: Pick the language in your profile; it is saved on all your devices.
